functions.docs: Hold the header value.

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs: Reset the context to a dummy state.

functions.name: IsDummy
functions.docs: @return true if this is a dummy context.

functions.name: IsError
functions.docs: @return true if this context represents an error code.

functions.name: IsBreak
functions.docs: @return true if this context represent a break code.

functions.name: IsString
functions.docs: @return true if this context represents a string type.

functions.name: IsContainer
functions.docs: @return true if this context represents a container. (indefinite string are containers.)

functions.docs: @return true if this context represents an indefinite container.

functions.docs: @return the context as a string.

functions.docs: @return the context as a string.
